item.title: 12kg LPG price reduced by Tk 15
item.description: The Bangladesh Energy Regulatory Commission (BERC) has reduced the price of a 12kg liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) cylinder by Tk 15, bringing it down from Tk 1,356 to Tk 1,341, following a government move to lower the tax on LPG imports.In a notification issued on Tuesday, BERC said the revised rate came into effect on February 23."The adjustment was necessitated by a change in the tax framework," the notice stated.Earlier, the National Board of Revenue (NBR) withdrew VAT at the production stage

item.title: Revenue shortfall crosses Tk 60,000cr in 7 months
item.description: Bangladesh's revenue shortfall exceeded Tk 60,000 crore in the first seven months (July-January) of fiscal year 2025-26, according to the National Board of Revenue (NBR). At the end of December, after six months, the deficit stood at around Tk 46,000 crore, indicating a widening gap in January.NBR statistics show that the revenue collection target for July-January was Tk 2,83,751 crore. item.title: Pakistan, Afghan forces exchange fire after airstrikes deepen tensions

item.title: FIFA boss 'very reassured' about WC in Mexico despite violence
item.description: FIFA boss Gianni Infantino told AFP on Tuesday he was "very reassured" about Mexico's hosting of games in the football World Cup, in his first comments on the violence triggered by the killing of a drug cartel leader."Very reassured, everything's good. item.title: 17yrs since the brutal Pilkhana tragedy: Nation observes National Martyred Army Day
item.description: Bangladesh on Wednesday marks the 17th anniversary of the tragic Pilkhana massacre, one of the darkest chapters in the nation's history.On February 25, 2009, the then Bangladesh Rifles (BDR) mutiny broke out simultaneously in different parts of the country. The most brutal killings, however, took place at the BDR headquarters in Pilkhana, Dhaka.A total of 74 people, including 57 army officers, were killed in the carnage. item.title: Jubo League leader Samrat jailed for 20yrs in graft case
item.description: A Dhaka court has sentenced former Jubo League leader Ismail Hossain Chowdhury Samrat to 20 years in prison in a corruption case filed by the Anti-Corruption Commission (ACC).Judge Md Zakaria Hossain of Dhaka Special Judge's Court-6 delivered the verdict on Wednesday.According to the verdict, the court handed him 10 years' rigorous imprisonment and a fine of Tk 10 lakh for amassing illegal wealth under the ACC law. item.title: Health concerns prompt Saudi Arabia to ban poultry imports from Bangladesh, 39 countries

item.title: Bank official's mysterious death at Bogura rehab centre, family alleges murder
item.description: A senior official of Janata Bank died on Tuesday night, 11 days after being admitted to a drug rehabilitation centre in Bogura.Deceased Samiul Hasan Shuvo was a resident of Kazipara village in Kahaloo upazila and was serving as a senior officer at the Dupchanchia branch of Janata Bank.According to police and hospital sources, staff from the Mayer Ashroy De-addiction Centre brought Shuvo to Bogura Shaheed Ziaur Rahman Medical College Hospital at around 7:30PM on Tuesday.
